note: Only harness/loop.sh changes `passes`. Features with `manual: true` are checked by a person.

features.title: Cargo workspace and lint baseline
features.description: Cargo workspace with crates `custodiod` (service: lib + bin), `custodio-pkcs11` (cdylib) and `custodio-cli` (import tool). `rust-toolchain.toml` pinned, `Cargo.lock` committed. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` in every crate except `custodio-pkcs11`. Workspace lints: clippy `pedantic` denied; in `custodiod` also `unwrap_used`, `expect_used`, `panic` and `indexing_slicing`.
features.verify: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace

features.title: just and lefthook entry point, repository linters
features.description: `justfile` with `fmt`, `lint`, `test`, `check` (fast: fmt, clippy, unit tests, taplo, typos, shellcheck) and `check-slow` (later features add to it). `lefthook.yml`: fast checks on pre-commit, slow ones on pre-push. Config for taplo and typos.

features.title: CI workflow
features.description: GitHub Actions workflow that runs `just check` and `just check-slow` and blocks the merge. Pinned actions, minimal permissions. actionlint and zizmor clean, and both added to `just check`.

features.title: Supply chain checks
features.description: `deny.toml`: advisories, licences compatible with EUPL-1.2, banned and duplicate crates, allowed sources. cargo-machete for unused dependencies. Both in `just check`.
features.verify: just check && cargo deny check && cargo machete

features.title: Key store
features.description: Key store in `custodiod`: plain files in a configurable state directory, directory 0700 and files 0600, created atomically. Key material in `secrecy`/`zeroize` types. Tests for the permissions and that `Debug` never prints key material.

features.title: .p12 import
features.description: Parse a `.p12` with its password. Accept only RSA 2048 and ECDSA P-256 keys with their certificate; reject anything else with a clear error. Store through the key store. Fuzz target for the `.p12` parser and a `just fuzz-build` recipe that builds all fuzz targets.

features.title: Signing primitives
features.description: Sign caller-provided data with a stored key for the PKCS#11 mechanisms consumers use: `CKM_RSA_PKCS`, `CKM_RSA_PKCS_PSS` and `CKM_ECDSA`. Known-answer and verify-roundtrip tests.

features.title: polkit authorization
features.description: Call polkit `CheckAuthorization` for `com.rfirma.custodio.sign` with a `system-bus-name` subject for the D-Bus sender and `AllowUserInteraction`, behind a trait so tests can fake it. Policy file `data/com.rfirma.custodio.policy` with `auth_self` for active, inactive and any, and a test that fails if any default is a `_keep` variant.

features.title: D-Bus service
features.description: `custodiod` owns `com.rfirma.Custodio1` at `/com/rfirma/Custodio1` (zbus): list keys and certificates, import a `.p12`, sign. Every sign call asks polkit first. Integration tests against a private `dbus-daemon` with a fake polkit authority on that bus: approve signs; deny returns an error and produces no signature; two signatures in a row ask twice. Fuzz target for the D-Bus method arguments. `just test-integration` recipe, added to `check-slow`.
features.verify: just check && just test-integration && just fuzz-build

features.title: Import CLI
features.description: `custodio import <file.p12>` reads the password from the terminal (never from argv or the environment), sends it to the service, and tells the person to delete the original file afterwards.

features.title: PKCS#11 module
features.description: `libcustodio-pkcs11.so` modelled on siguldry-pkcs11 (fedora-infra/siguldry): exposes one token per key, lets consumers list the certificate, find the private key object and `C_SignInit`/`C_Sign`, forwarding to the service over D-Bus. Everything else returns `CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED`. Safe across threads and `fork`. p11-kit `.module` file. Integration test that loads the built module through the `cryptoki` crate against the private bus.

features.title: FFI safety
features.description: The FFI layer of `custodio-pkcs11` runs under Miri (`just miri`) and its tests under AddressSanitizer (`just asan`). Fuzz target for the PKCS#11 arguments the module receives. All three in `check-slow`.
features.verify: just miri && just asan && just fuzz-build

features.title: Mutation testing
features.description: `just mutants` runs cargo-mutants on the authorization path and the key store; any surviving mutant fails. Add tests until none survive. In `check-slow`.

features.title: Coverage report and CRAP gate
features.description: `just coverage` produces a cargo-llvm-cov report (not a target). `just crap` fails when a function's CRAP score exceeds a fixed threshold. Both in `check-slow`.

features.title: systemd unit, D-Bus policy, hardening gate
features.description: `custodio.service` with `DynamicUser=`, `StateDirectory=custodio` and hardening options; D-Bus system policy for the bus name. `just security-score` fails if `systemd-analyze security --offline=yes` exposure exceeds a fixed threshold. In `check`.

features.title: .deb package
features.description: `just package` builds one `.deb` (cargo-deb) that installs the binaries, the systemd unit, the D-Bus policy, the polkit action and the p11-kit `.module`.

features.title: End-to-end tests
features.description: `just e2e`: in a systemd container or VM with the package installed, real polkit and a test authentication agent that approves or denies on demand. Sign with `pkcs11-tool` and through NSS (`modutil`, `certutil`): approve, deny, and second signature asks again. Acceptance 1: the user cannot read the key files.

features.title: Open questions
features.description: `docs/findings.md` answers the open questions in SPEC.md with evidence from experiments or sources: `CKA_ALWAYS_AUTHENTICATE` in NSS and OpenSSL; D-Bus client behaviour in Firefox and LibreOffice (threads, fork); which target distributions meet polkit 124 and a bus exposing `ProcessFD`.

features.title: Acceptance 2, 3 and 6 by hand
features.description: rFirma signs with the token, Firefox uses it for TLS client authentication, each signature shows the polkit dialog, and fingerprint works with pam_fprintd.
